name: rg-render-probe
description: Dev-only anchor: `_probe/host/repl.mjs` calls createRequire on this file so both benches resolve jsdom, react and react-dom from the same place. The versions live in the root package.json devDependencies and nowhere else — a second manifest with its own versions is how two benches end up running on two different jsdoms.
//: No dependencies here on purpose. `npm install` at the repository root installs everything the benches need.
